layers.population: Meta High Resolution Settlement Layer (HRSL), ~30 m, CC-BY 4.0
layers.canopy: ESA WorldCover 2021 v200, 10 m, tree-cover class, CC-BY 4.0 (computed on Google Earth Engine)
layers.lst: Landsat 8/9 C2 L2 surface temperature, QA-masked median of 8 May 2026 scenes, computed on Google Earth Engine
layers.osm: OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL (bus stops, markets, guarded sites, roads, boundary)
layers.synthetic: Guard posts, rehri zones, worksites, homeless spots and labour chowks marked 'synthetic' are sampled in proportion to population for the demo; shelters marked 'demo' are placeholders
